text.tspan: Task: add a refresh-token flow to the auth module
First I check the project memory for rules on auth and sessions.
[mementic: 1 of 1 constraints, 2 of 3 decisions | auth, tokens, session]
- Sessions must stay stateless (#sessions-stay-stateless, bound: src/api/session.py)
- Tokens carry the session (#use-jwt-auth, affects: src/api/auth.py)
There is a constraint: sessions must stay stateless. A refresh-token flow still fits
if the refresh token rotates and nothing is stored server side.
Before opening the module, the file gate:
Outcome: I will implement the refresh flow with rotating tokens
This decision is new. Recording it so the next session finds it:
Graph updated. I will query again before the next module.
